name: The browser wars
description: Hand-picked: Netscape against Internet Explorer, the browsers that came after, and the web languages and plug-ins they fought over.
author: codegrave

checkpoints.name: The first browser war
checkpoints.note: Internet Explorer arrives in August 1995 and, bundled with Windows, overtakes Netscape. By the time Internet Explorer 6 ships in 2001 the war is over.

checkpoints.name: The second browser war
checkpoints.note: Firefox 1.0 (2004) and then Chrome (2008) win users back from a stalled Internet Explorer, until Microsoft replaces it with Edge in Windows 10 in 2015.
